notes: canonical strings are byte-exact: compact JSON, members in the wire order pinned by the schema doc sections 4-7.

request_failures / response_failures pin the stable decode error strings shared by both codecs; error_prefix matches by prefix because the C++ parser appends its own diagnostic after "payload is not valid JSON".

v2 (M1.5-02): events.subscribe / events.unsubscribe are protocol v1 requests on both ends; the former unknown-op-events-* failure vectors were dropped as obsolete (superseded by unknown-op-registry-edit for the unknown-op stable error).
events and event_failures sections are consumed by both codecs since M1.5-02; hello-capability's events identity member encodes on both ends.

v3 (M5-03): permission.* async confirmation surface (DEC-020) — permission.respond / permission.list requests, permission.request event, hello 'permissions' capability member; wire order pinned by schema doc sections 4, 6.1, 6.3 and 7.2.

v4 (M5-04): session.* conversation face (DEC-021) — session.list / session.open / session.history requests, session.updated / session.message / session.turn / session.output events, task.submit optional session_id binding, TaskSubmitted session_id echo, hello 'sessions' capability member; wire order pinned by schema doc sections 4, 6.1, 6.4 and 7.2.

v5 (M5-05): workflow.* contract face (DEC-023) — workflow.list / workflow.save / workflow.publish / workflow.delete / workflow.atom.catalog / workflow.runs / workflow.run / workflow.cancel requests, workflow.run_updated event, hello 'workflows' capability member; wire order pinned by schema doc sections 4, 6.1, 6.5 and 7.2.
